about.title: Visit
about.body: The tasting room sits on the terrace above the vines, with views across the valley to the Mayacamas. Choose the Estate tasting of five wines on the terrace, or the 90-minute Vineyard and cellar walk that ends with a barrel tasting.
about.photoHint: The terrace and the view across the valley

about.title: Our Story
about.body: Daniel and Rosa Hale planted their first vines on a steep, rocky ridge above St. Helena in 1998, when everyone told them it was too steep to farm. Today their daughter Maya makes the wines, and the whole family still picks at harvest.

about.title: Wines
about.body: The family farms 40 acres organically and dry farms every block, with no irrigation, so the roots go deep. Every cluster is picked by hand in the cool early morning, and the wines are made in a stone winery built into the hillside, with a barrel cave that stays cool all year.
about.photoHint: The vineyard rows and the barrel cave

about.title: Ridge Club
about.body: Three shipments a year of the newest releases, chosen by Maya, with tasting notes and recipes. Members get first access to library wines, two tastings a year on the house, and an invitation to the members-only harvest lunch.
about.photoHint: Club members at the harvest lunch

about.title: Gift Guide
about.body: The Ridge Trio for the holidays, the Holiday Pair for a host, and a magnum for a big celebration. Gift cards come in any amount. Order by December 15 for Christmas delivery.
about.photoHint: The gift boxes, wrapped and ready

about.title: Weddings & Gatherings
about.body: Say yes on the terrace above the vines, with room for up to 120 guests from May to October. Private dinners and company gatherings for up to 40 guests are held in the barrel cave all year.

about.title: Recipes
about.body: Cook along with the winery: Rosa's braised short ribs with Cabernet, grilled ribeye with rosemary salt, and wild mushroom risotto for the Chardonnay. Each recipe comes with the wine the family pours with it.
about.photoHint: Rosa's short ribs with a glass of Cabernet
